base: GSI 29.15.11 (commit 4b3e94f) + the two targeted-debug fixes from the owner's 29.15.11 package
scope: Commercial Expert adapter rewritten on the file's exact 35 headers; part states (نزد سازنده/آماده حمل/در راه/در گمرک) from Order Status × Quantity In Part; phantom and duplicate expert headers removed from every report.
business_logic_change_note: Expert supply quantities now come only from Quantity In Part by Order Status (in customs net of Customs Cleared Quantity); the former supplier = Order − Part and the discharge-date split are removed. A fourth state, READY_QTY (آماده حمل), joins the supply position. Criticality (Oracle-based), commitments and penalties are unchanged.

validation.this_release_result: 1547 passed, 0 failed (working tree); re-verified from the clean ZIP extraction
validation.ab_test: tools/ab, 29.15.11 vs 29.15.12: dataset with the exact 35 headers — 6 of 10 materials had their quantity in the wrong state and now follow Order Status; complete supply coverage 0→6; criticality, resistance, commitments, penalties and scorecard identical. Old-format data — only change is a removed guess (supplier = Order − Part).

source_authority_change_note: The expert file contract is exactly its 35 headers (EXPERT_HEADERS); no field is read or invented beyond them. Order Status is now authoritative for a part's state.
